boundaries.responsibility: API verifies identity and checks current RBAC before body, existence, or effects.
staging_checks: Real OIDC expiry, wrong issuer/audience, key rotation and revoked roles for both tenants.
Browser proxy forwards individual identities; session expiry, sign-out, forged headers and CSRF denied; API upstream certificate verified.

boundaries.responsibility: Trusted principal selects catalog schema, physical prefix, search and citation scope; default aliases must never access named tenants.
staging_checks: Use identical keys in pilot-a/pilot-b: foreign object, job, hold IDs, cursors, citations and downloads reveal nothing.
Reproduce #156 on affected baseline and verify candidate on a real case-insensitive volume; record selected ext4 comparison/mount identity. Full semantic providers remain excluded.

boundaries.responsibility: Only trusted producers assert identity; worker revalidates current policy and tenant binding before leases, effects, retries and redrive.
staging_checks: Attempt untrusted publish, forged actor/role metadata, wrong tenant, expired/revoked producer credentials and subscriber access with real NATS ACL/TLS.
Queue while authorized, revoke role/tenant, deliver/retry/redrive on actual worker; no effects. Verify disabled schedules, TLS reconnect and bounded DLQ.

boundaries.responsibility: Catalog legal holds and mutation exclusion preserve held bytes across overwrite/delete/move/cleanup; placement and release retain immutable audit.
staging_checks: Concurrent hold placement/release and destructive work in both tenants across API and worker replicas; verify bytes, generations, holds and audit on actual POSIX/S3.

boundaries.responsibility: Durable intent/outcome and append-only chains precede disclosure/settlement; independently retained checkpoints detect privileged history rewrites.
staging_checks: Export tenant evidence to independent restricted durable storage; verify against an external checkpoint after tampering and restore.
Fail catalog audit persistence before intent/ACK/disclosure and after physical I/O; reconcile unresolved intents without concealing failures.

boundaries.responsibility: Secret resolution/rotation and diagnostic redaction must not disclose credentials; production transport and encryption attestations fail closed.
staging_checks: Rotate actual secret versions and TLS/KMS keys; old access fails, current access and retained-key restore work.
Inspect sanitized logs, traces, browser output and alerts; platform evidence verifies all persistent/temporary storage and backups encrypted.

boundaries.responsibility: Bound API upload/JSON bodies, isolate document parser and suppress PII content where configured.
staging_checks: Exercise 16 MiB object and 256 KiB JSON bounds, corrupt/encrypted documents, parser timeout/output limits; measure actual RSS, /tmp and /dev/shm.
Synthetic data only; PII disabled and model providers absent per pilot selection.

boundaries.responsibility: Per-key cross-process mutation fences serialize storage plus catalog publication and preserve replacement generations.
staging_checks: Reproduce #157 on affected baseline and verify candidate: overlap DELETE/replacement PUT both orders, publication failures, crash/restart and competing API replicas.
Verify byte checksums, generation, content references and catalog agree after each barrier on ext4 and native versioned S3.

boundaries.responsibility: Durable move checkpoints, conditional deletion and generation fences preserve replacements through retries, verification, crash and publication failures.
staging_checks: Overlap PUT/DELETE and hot-to-warm/warm-to-hot moves at every checkpoint across processes; kill worker and recover from retained move identity.
Native S3 version/conditional-write semantics, checksum validation and SSE-KMS must be exercised; MinIO/emulation is supplemental.

boundaries.responsibility: Scanner must not republish obsolete placement or observations across active/completed moves and catalog failures.
staging_checks: Overlap scans with PUT/DELETE/move from API and worker against production catalog/backends, including crash after storage read before observation publish.

boundaries.responsibility: Read-only reports and reviewed repair plans are tenant/source-bound; repairs revalidate generations, leases and holds before effects.
staging_checks: Race reviewed repair with foreground writes, scans, moves and holds; stale scope/generation must reject or quarantine. Interrupt/resume each allowed action.
Named-tenant admin/harness only; ordinary CLI writers are restricted to separate default-tenant fixtures.

boundaries.responsibility: Orphan quarantine/reclaim requires durable intent, unchanged generation/reference state, no hold and no active ownership.
staging_checks: Race reclaim with new references, holds, PUT/DELETE/move/repair across actual API/worker processes; crash after deletion and before audit completion must reconcile.

boundaries.responsibility: Selected one-node POSIX/S3, PostgreSQL16, persistent TLS JetStream and metadata-only composition are reviewed as a single deployment.
staging_checks: Record actual image, rendered configuration, service versions, filesystem/node/volume identity, network enforcement and least privilege.
Deny plaintext/untrusted TLS and forbidden ingress/egress; tenant metrics stay private; real alert delivery and backup/restore evidence required.

boundaries.responsibility: Freeze source, image, wheel/dependency/native inventory, migrations and provider absence; disposition every release-blocking finding.
staging_checks: Verify frozen artifact installation and registry manifest association, dependency/SBOM/image scans with database freshness, owner-reviewed findings and durable artifact retention.
Retest exact candidate after code/config/dependency changes; hosted qualification remains explicitly skipped under standing instruction.
